page: Vultr vcg-h100-216c-1914gb-640vram is a Dedicated Metal GPU server configured with 216 dedicated Intel vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 1884.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.72 GB of RAM per core to support memory-intensive operations.

The hardware configuration features eight NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 640 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local storage is provided by 13312 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, facilitating high-speed data access. The server also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

This server represents a high-density hardware class designed for massive parallel processing and compute-heavy workloads. It is suited for large-scale artificial intelligence training, deep learning inference, high-performance computing simulations, and intensive data analytics.
